title: avonia recurvata subsp. minuta
intro: Avonia recurvata subsp. minuta, commonly known as Dwarf Elephant's Foot, is a succulent plant species in the family Portulacaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various ailments, including fever, rheumatism, and wounds. The health benefits of this plant include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing pain and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Avonia recurvata subsp. minuta include flavonoids, alkaloids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
